entry.author: NZ On Air Music
entry.summary:
Blending Afrofusion and R&B, Imani-J is a rising superstar with a powerful story, one which includes a collab with the iconic Bam Marley on their song ‘Talk Is Cheap’ 🔥✨ Charlotte Ryan sits down with her at the Big Fan desk to dive into the journey so far.
